item.text: I found the generated PNG under the Codex generated-images directory. Next I’m copying that exact image to the requested storyboard frame path and writing the checksum receipt from the copied PNG.

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "src='/home/graham/.codex/generated_images/019f3e63-1fd6-7621-8af9-63f130cf19a8/ig_00bea8391b46fb67016a4d6950222881909ed71808d28579c5.png'
out='/mnt/storage12tb/persona-dream/phase07_tau_runs/run-20260707T204134Z-sequential-storyboard/work/generated_storyboard_frames/sb_003_end_frame.png'
receipt='/mnt/storage12tb/persona-dream/phase07_tau_runs/run-20260707T204134Z-sequential-storyboard/work/receipts/storyboard_frame_generation/sb_003_end_frame_scillm_image_generation_receipt.json'
mkdir -p \""'$(dirname "$out")" "$(dirname "$receipt")"
cp "$src" "$out"
read width height < <(identify -format '"'%w %h' \""'$out")
sha=$(sha256sum "$out" | awk '"'{print "'$1}'"')
printf '{\\n  \"ok\": true,\\n  \"auth\": \"Codex OAuth subscription image_gen\",\\n  \"path\": \"%s\",\\n  \"width\": %s,\\n  \"height\": %s,\\n  \"sha256\": \"%s\"\\n}\\n' \""'$out" "$width" "$height" "$sha" > "$receipt"
test -f "$out" && test -f "$receipt"
ls -l "$out" "$receipt"
printf '"'\\nreceipt:\\n'
cat \""'$receipt"'
